    2. Support, resistance and price zones

    Support, resistance and price zones

    The areas where price reacts; level tests, breakouts, false breakouts and retests.

    • What are support and resistance?

      • Support and resistance

      Support is a price area where falling price has stopped and turned up before; resistance is an area where rising price has stopped and turned down before.

    • Testing a level

      • Support and resistance

      A level test is when price comes back to a support or resistance zone and reacts there.

    • Breakouts and the close

      • Support and resistance

      A breakout is a candle closing beyond the far edge of a support or resistance zone.

    • False breakout: the wick versus the close

      • Support and resistance

      A false breakout is when price moves beyond a support or resistance zone and returns behind it before the candle closes.

    • Sweep: a wick past the range edge

      • Support and resistance

      A sweep is when price wicks beyond the top or bottom of a range and closes the candle back inside the range.

    • Retests and role reversal: returning to a broken zone

      • Support and resistance

      A retest is price returning to a zone after breaking it.

    • Historical highs and lows: references left by the past

      • Support and resistance

      The all-time high (ATH), multi-year highs and lows, and the previous week's or month's high and low are reference areas anyone can see on a chart.

    • Psychological levels: why round numbers matter

      • Support and resistance

      Psychological levels are round numbers such as 100,000 for BTC or 1.00 for some assets.
